hook: OpenSSL patches a critical base64 buffer overflow.

beats.say: A public OpenSSL pull request fixes CVE-2026-121481, a buffer overflow in the EVP Encode Block base64 encoder, rated 9.8 out of 10.
The fix rejects NULL buffers, negative lengths, and inputs whose encoded size would not fit in an int.
It adds a similar guard to EVP Decode Block, fixes a bad length check in the HTTP client's base64 encoder, and adds new tests, across branches 4.0 and 4.1.
